nodes.label: sapi_module_struct
nodes.desc: Vtable with startup, shutdown, activate, deactivate, read_post, read_cookies, send_header slots.

nodes.label: cli_sapi_module
nodes.desc: Concrete CLI SAPI: startup hooks php_module_startup, ub_write writes to stdout.

nodes.label: sapi_activate
nodes.desc: Activates the SAPI for one request: request info, headers, POST reader setup.

nodes.label: do_php_cli
nodes.desc: CLI entry point; calls module startup, then the request cycle per file executed.

nodes.label: php_module_startup
nodes.desc: MINIT phase: copies the SAPI in, calls zend_startup, loads php.ini, runs module MINIT.

nodes.label: zend_startup
nodes.desc: Boots the Zend engine: globals, memory manager, opcode tables.

nodes.label: php_request_startup
nodes.desc: RINIT: zend_activate, sapi_activate, zend_set_timeout, zend_activate_modules. Extension MINIT is bound via the ZEND_MODULE_STARTUP_N macro in Zend/zend_API.h.

nodes.label: zend_activate
nodes.desc: Per-request engine reset: gc_reset, init_compiler, init_executor, startup_scanner.

nodes.label: zend_activate_modules
nodes.desc: Runs each extension's RINIT; symmetrical deactivate runs RSHUTDOWN.

nodes.label: php_execute_script
nodes.desc: PHP layer over one script execution, handling cwd, prepend and append files.

nodes.label: php_request_shutdown
nodes.desc: Twelve numbered steps: shutdown functions, destructors, output flush, RSHUTDOWN, super-globals.

nodes.label: zend_compile_file (pointer)
nodes.desc: Function pointer variable; default implementation is compile_file in the scanner.

nodes.label: compile_file
nodes.desc: Default zend_compile_file: open and scan the file, then zend_compile.

nodes.label: open_file_for_scanning
nodes.desc: re2c lexer setup: opens the file and primes the scanner state.

nodes.label: zend_compile
nodes.desc: Runs zendparse to build an AST, then zend_compile_ast_internal.

nodes.label: zendparse
nodes.desc: Bison parser entry: consumes tokens from the re2c lexer, builds a Zend AST.

nodes.label: zend_compile_top_stmt
nodes.desc: Walks the AST and emits opcodes into a zend_op_array.

nodes.label: zend_execute_script
nodes.desc: Calls zend_compile_file, then zend_execute; destroys the op_array afterwards.

nodes.label: struct _zend_op
nodes.desc: One opcode: handler pointer, op1/op2/result operands, opcode number, lineno.

nodes.label: struct _zend_op_array
nodes.desc: Compiled unit: opcode array, literals, vars, try/catch table.

nodes.label: struct _zend_execute_data
nodes.desc: One VM stack frame: current opline, function, CVs, this, return value.

nodes.label: zend_execute
nodes.desc: Pushes a top-level call frame for the op_array and calls zend_execute_ex.

nodes.label: execute_ex
nodes.desc: The interpreter loop: dispatch each specialized handler until return.

nodes.label: zend_vm_set_opcode_handler
nodes.desc: Picks the specialized handler for an opcode at compile time.

nodes.label: ZEND_ASSIGN handler
nodes.desc: Opcode 22: zval assignment, with copy-on-write and refcount handling.

nodes.label: ZEND_DO_FCALL handler
nodes.desc: Opcode 60: hot function-call opcode that pushes a new frame and enters it.

nodes.label: ZEND_RETURN handler
nodes.desc: Opcode 62: copies the result to the caller frame and leaves the current one.

nodes.label: struct _zval_struct
nodes.desc: value union plus u1 type tag plus u2 scratch field: the 16-byte PHP variable.

nodes.label: zend_refcounted_h
nodes.desc: Header on strings, arrays, objects: refcount plus type_info.

nodes.label: GC_ADDREF
nodes.desc: Atomic refcount increment macro used across the engine.

nodes.label: persistent_compile_file
nodes.desc: Checks shared-memory cache; on miss compiles and stores a persistent copy.

nodes.label: zend_accel_load_script
nodes.desc: Materializes a cached op_array from shared memory for execution.

nodes.label: zend_jit_op_array
nodes.desc: Function-mode JIT: SSA-analyzes an op_array and emits machine code.

nodes.label: zend_jit_trace_execute
nodes.desc: Tracing JIT: records hot loops seen by the VM, then compiles them.
